summary.zh: 把价值观落成可观察的行为与仪式
summary.en: Turn company values into observable behaviors and rituals

description.zh: 帮助定义公司价值观，并把它拆成可观察的行为和日常仪式，而不是贴在墙上的口号。可用于评估文化健康状况、找出宣称与实际做法的差距。适合组织变大后需要把文化讲清楚的时候。
description.en: Defines company values and turns them into observable behaviors and everyday rituals instead of wall posters. Also assesses culture health and the gap between what is said and done. For a company past informal culture.
